search_text: published ZDI-24-1294 ZDI-CAN-22537 Western Digital MyCloud PR4100 ddns-start Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-09-26 CVE-2024-22170 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-22170 7.5 AV:A/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Western Digital'] ['MyCloud PR4100'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Western Digital MyCloud PR4100. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of HTTP responses provided to the ddns-start program. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Western Digital has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Western Digital MyCloud PR4100 ddns-start Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Western Digital MyCloud PR4100. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of HTTP responses provided to the ddns-start program. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device.
